newsitem.title: USA: DOE's Pena to help ease natural gas delays.
newsitem.headline: DOE's Pena to help ease natural gas delays.

text.p: Department of Energy Secretary Federico Pena plans to assemble an inter-agency committee to help natural gas producers in the Rocky Mountain region with lease approvals on federal lands, he said on Friday.

"We talked about the possibility of my putting together a sort of an inter-departmental team that can work together ... to address some of these issues on a real consensus basis and I'm happy to do that," Pena told reporters after addressing the Colorado Oil & Gas Assocation annual meeting.
Pena, who is a former mayor of Denver, met Friday with industry leaders who described problems in obtaining approval for drilling on federal lands in the Rocky Mountain region.
Pena said the natural gas industry leaders know the Clinton administration is "supportive of many of these issues" but implementing them sometimes runs into obstacles.
"My main message to the CEOs is that I'm here to work with them in a very supportive and cooperative way," Pena said.
Pena called the delays a "typical problem" in government.
